thread:
maria_clark: Quick sync — Tech Insights (Taylor Kim) asked for a briefing + embargo on our benchmark post. They want embargoed copy and a fact-check window. I uploaded the draft here: https://drive.google.com/example (see /marketing/press/drafts).
jamal_s: Got it. Do we have an embargo time yet? Taylor asked for 'AM PT' on the 15th.
maria_clark: Proposed embargo: 11:00 AM PT / 7:00 PM UTC on Thu Apr 15. Thoughts?
alex_pr: That works for the newsroom. Can we offer a 30-min pre-brief at 9:30 AM PT for Taylor + 1 analyst? They usually like a quick run-through.
sophia_p: 9:30 AM PT is ok for product. We'll need to confirm the key metric line — the headline TPS/cost numbers — before briefing. Current draft says "2.3x cost reduction" (internal perf run). I want to be explicit: is that median or p95?
jamal_s: Good catch. Taylor flagged the cost claim too. We should surface the test harness and dataset used.
andrew_legal: Legal: don't include customer-specific numbers or anything tied to named partners. Also avoid forward-looking promises. Phrase it as "in our internal benchmark, median token cost decreased by ~2.3x" if that's accurate.
sophia_p: Confirmed: it's median across our standard web-chat benchmark (internal harness v3). I'll paste the benchmark note block below for the fact-check doc:
```
Benchmark note: internal web-chat workload v3. Input distribution drawn from anonymized OSS customer prompts. Measurements repeated x5. Median token unit cost reduction = 2.3x vs baseline (v1). See appendix for config.
```
maria_clark: Perfect — I'm going to add that to the fact-check doc and send to Taylor. Alex, can you draft two quote options (one short, one long) for us to approve? Need them by EOD.
alex_pr: On it. Drafts: 1) "We're excited to show how Redwood Inference reduces inference cost while maintaining latency SLOs." 2) Longer: "Redwood Inference's latest serving stack reduces median token cost by ~2.3x in our internal benchmark while preserving sub-100ms tail latency for typical web-chat workloads; this helps teams ship LLM features at scale." Will post in thread for sign-off.
maria_clark: Please be careful with the "sub-100ms tail" claim — product, confirm p95/p99 and exact numbers.
sophia_p: We can say p95 < 100ms on the benchmark config. p99 is ~180ms. I'll confirm and add the p95 figure to the fact-check doc.
jamal_s: Once quotes are in, I'll route to Taylor with the embargo line and the fact-check doc. Taylor asked for a final sign-off 24 hours before pub. Can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when they've approved the quote + fact-check entries?
alex_pr: Drafts posted in the doc, tagging you @maria_clark.
press_bot: Reminder scheduled — embargo reminder will post to #marketing 12h before 11:00 AM PT on 2026-04-15.
maria_clark: Cool. Last check — availability for the 9:30 AM PT pre-brief: @sophia_p, @jamal_s, @alex_pr, @maria_clark all confirmed. Andrew, are you available in case Taylor presses legal?
andrew_legal: I can be on standby; will join if needed.
maria_clark: Thanks. I'll send the embargo line + fact-check doc to Taylor now and ask for the 9:30 slot. If anyone has edits to the quote, drop them in the doc fast. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
